statusDoctrine.pass: Surface consumes a registered contract id and exposes enough posture for proof or user review.
statusDoctrine.partial: Surface consumes contract-backed data but does not yet expose the contract id or trust posture clearly.
statusDoctrine.gap: Surface computes or displays suite-truth metrics without a registered contract id.
statusDoctrine.outOfScope: Surface is related domain functionality but needs a future domain-specific contract, not one of the four current suite contracts.
